## Figure 1.16: Ratio of External Debt Stock to GNI of Low-Income, Middle-Income, IDA-Eligible, and Low- and Middle-Income Countries (Excluding China), 2015–25
Type: line chart

- **Y-axis:** Percent, from **0 to 60**
- **X-axis:** Years, **2015–2025**
- **Series / legend:**
  - **Low-income countries** (dark blue)
  - **IDA-eligible countries** (orange)
  - **Middle-income countries** (light blue)
  - **Low- and middle-income countries (excl. China)** (gold)
- **Time span:** 2015–2025

### Approximate values by series
Values are estimated from line positions because no printed point labels are shown.

| Year | Low-income countries | IDA-eligible countries | Middle-income countries | Low- and middle-income countries (excl. China) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 2015 | ≈39 | ≈30 | ≈34 | ≈23.5 |
| 2016 | ≈44 | ≈31 | ≈34.5 | ≈24 |
| 2017 | ≈46 | ≈34.5 | ≈34.5 | ≈24.8 |
| 2018 | ≈46.5 | ≈35 | ≈35.5 | ≈24.8 |
| 2019 | ≈47 | ≈34 | ≈36 | ≈25.2 |
| 2020 | ≈52.5 | ≈38.5 | ≈40.5 | ≈27.5 |
| 2021 | ≈50 | ≈38.5 | ≈37.5 | ≈25 |
| 2022 | ≈44 | ≈36.5 | ≈35 | ≈23.8 |
| 2023 | ≈43.8 | ≈39.5 | ≈34 | ≈23.5 |
| 2024 | ≈41 | ≈41.5 | ≈33.2 | ≈22.8 |
| 2025 | ≈41.5–42 | ≈40.8–41 | ≈34 | ≈22.8 |

### Visual comparisons and trends
- **Low-income countries** are the **highest** series throughout the full period.
- This series rises from about **39 percent in 2015** to a **peak around 52–53 percent in 2020**, then declines to about **42 percent in 2025**.
- **IDA-eligible countries** begin near **30 percent** in 2015, climb overall with some fluctuation, and end around **41 percent** in 2025.
- **Middle-income countries** remain below low-income countries but above the LMIC aggregate excluding China for all years; they rise to around **40–41 percent in 2020** and then fall back to about **34 percent by 2025**.
- **Low- and middle-income countries (excluding China)** are the **lowest** series in every year, moving from about **23–25 percent** in 2015–19 to a local peak near **27–28 percent in 2020**, then declining to about **23 percent by 2024–25**.
- Around **2024**, **IDA-eligible countries** slightly **overtake low-income countries**; by **2025** the two series are very close, with **low-income countries marginally higher**.
- The **widest spread** between the highest and lowest series appears around **2020**, when low-income countries peak while LMICs excluding China remain below 30 percent.

**Source:** World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.  
**Note:** GNI = gross national income; IDA = International Development Association.
